intervention_dose: 1 mg IV step-up D1, 10 mg D8/D15 of cycle 1, then 10 mg q2w (28-day cycles)
population_detail: SCLC after platinum-based therapy and ≥1 prior line; ECOG 0-1; brain mets allowed if treated
median_dor_or_pfs: mDoR not reached at 10.6 mo follow-up; mPFS 4.9 mo
safety_summary: CRS in ~50% (mostly grade 1-2; grade ≥3 in ~1%); ICANS-like neurologic events ~10%; treatment-related AEs G3+ in 30%
notes: Pivotal trial driving FDA accelerated approval. Cross-tumor row: patient has osteosarcoma, not SCLC — included as the load-bearing efficacy evidence the basket trial NCT06788938 extrapolates from.

outcomes.name: TRAE_rate
outcomes.notes: G>=3 treatment-related AEs, tarlatamab arm; 53% on chemo comparator

safety_summary: Confirmed CRS profile from phase-2; G3+ TRAEs 24% vs 53% chemo arm — favorable safety vs comparator
notes: Confirmatory phase-3 OS benefit in SCLC. Establishes mechanism convincingly; cross-tumor extrapolation to osteosarcoma still requires DLL3 IHC confirmation.

exclusion_reason: Drug discontinued by sponsor (AbbVie withdrew Rova-T after the TAHOE phase-3 SCLC trial showed worse OS vs topotecan). Mechanism (DLL3-targeted PBD-warhead ADC) is informative for the target rationale but the molecule itself is not procurable.

population_detail: Heavily pretreated melanoma; subset with prior immunotherapy; HLA-A*02:01-positive; PRAME-positive by IHC
variance_or_ci: 95% CI in heavily pretreated melanoma; mDoR > 6 mo in responders
median_dor_or_pfs: mPFS 2.1 mo overall; durable responses in subset

outcomes.name: DoR
outcomes.notes: durable in responder subset; median not separately reported

safety_summary: Cytokine release syndrome ~85% (mostly G1-2); rash ~70%; transient hypotension; G3+ TRAEs ~30%; manageable with dexamethasone pre-medication.
notes: First-in-class PRAME × CD3 ImmTAC. Cross-tumor: melanoma data, not osteosarcoma. Establishes the ImmTAC-platform mechanism for PRAME — same fusion-protein architecture as tebentafusp (gp100 × CD3) which has approved indication in uveal melanoma. [Corrected: prior PMID 39007852 was a wrong-identifier bug (resolved to an unrelated breast-cancer paper); nulled per reference-check. Verified brenetafusp Phase-1 data is the ASCO 2024 abstract, DOI 10.1200/JCO.2024.42.16_suppl.9507.]

intervention_dose: 1-10 × 10⁹ TCR-T cells IV after Cy/Flu lymphodepletion
indication: PRAME-positive HLA-A*02:01-positive refractory solid tumors (basket: melanoma, sarcomas including synovial sarcoma, ovarian, NSCLC, head and neck, uterine, others)
population_detail: Heavily pretreated PRAME+ HLA-A*02:01+ patients; subset of synovial sarcoma cohort enrolled; lymphodepleting Cy/Flu prior to infusion
variance_or_ci: 95% CI in evaluable cohort; mDoR not reached at 9-mo follow-up

outcomes.name: TRAE_rate
outcomes.notes: secondary outcomes pending verification — see toxicities[] for per-term breakdown

safety_summary: CRS ~100% (G1-2 majority; G3-4 ~10%); ICANS-like neurotoxicity ~25% (mostly G1-2); cytopenias post-Cy/Flu uniform; 1 treatment-related death.
notes: Pan-solid PRAME-TCR-T basket including sarcoma cohorts. Best clinical-efficacy signal in the PRAME class to date. Lymphodepletion logistics + CAR-T-style infusion infrastructure required.

intervention_label: tarlatamab + radiation therapy (DLL3 × CD3 BiTE + RT)
intervention_dose: tarlatamab per label step-up dosing plus standard palliative/consolidative RT to an extracranial site; regimen not yet reported
indication: DLL3-expressing solid tumors, pan-tumor basket with a non-SCLC phase 2 expansion (NCT06814496)
population_detail: Histologies with high DLL3 prevalence and an extracranial site amenable to radiation; DLL3 IHC ≥1% gate; nested phase 2 enriches for non-SCLC tumors
design: first-in-human phase 1/2 single-arm, tarlatamab with concurrent or sequential radiation
outcome: DLT / safety of the RT combination; ORR in the non-SCLC phase 2 expansion

outcomes.name: other
outcomes.notes: DLT / RT-combination safety is the primary phase 1 readout; no efficacy reported yet

safety_summary: No combination safety data yet. The BiTE component carries the tarlatamab class profile (CRS ~50% mostly G1-2, ICANS-like neurologic events ~10%); the RT arm adds site-specific radiation toxicity that this trial is designed to characterize.
notes: Registry-only; no combination efficacy or safety published (trial recruiting, University of Arizona). Rationale rests on the abscopal hypothesis layered onto tarlatamab monotherapy efficacy (DeLLphi-301/304, rows ce-1/ce-2) and its phase 1 SCLC safety (Paz-Ares/Owonikoko, JCO 2023, PMID 36689692). toxicities[] empty because no combination AE data exists yet: NCT06814496 has no results tab and no abstract. Pan-tumor DLL3-IHC gate could admit an IHC-positive osteosarcoma; confirm bone sarcoma is on the per-protocol list.

outcome: ORR; DCR; mPFS in PRAME-positive vs PRAME-negative

safety_summary: No clinical safety data published. Class expectation for PRAME TCR-T is CRS and ICANS-like neurotoxicity plus lymphodepletion cytopenias, as seen with IMA203 (row osteo-prame-ce-2).
notes: Registry-only; Neowise phase 1 recruiting, no publication or abstract found for NW-101C (searchable name returns no clinical data; the Neowise TCR-T with published data is NW-301V targeting KRAS G12V, a different agent). toxicities[] empty because no source AE data exists. Pan-solid PRAME/HLA-A*02:01 eligibility could admit osteosarcoma if both biomarkers confirm; verify sarcoma is accepted. Efficacy precedent for the PRAME TCR-T class is IMA203 (osteo-prame-ce-2).
